# Export — PRD

Owner: Test · Epic:
[ACME-1](https://linear.app/acme/issue/ACME-1)

## 1. Scope

**Not doing:**

| Item | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Scheduled export by email | Later. |
| PDF report export | No demand. |

## 2. Requirements

#### FR-1 — People export their data

- **FR-1.1** Given a list, when someone exports it, then they get a file.
- **FR-1.2** Given a large list, when someone exports it, then the file arrives within a minute.
- **FR-1.3** Given an export, when it fails, then the person sees why.
